newsitem.title: USA: Republicans hold Wyoming Senate seat.
newsitem.headline: Republicans hold Wyoming Senate seat.

text.p: Republicans held Wyoming's Senate seat with the victory of state Sen. Mike Enzi over Democratic lawyer Kathy Karpan, television networks projected Tuesday.

Karpan, a two-term secretary of state, had the name recognition advantage but Enzi, a conservative legislator, was closer to the mold of Wyoming's retiring Republican Sen. Alan Simpson. Enzi endeavored to paint Karpan as too liberal for the state. Republicans needed to keep this Senate seat or risk seeing erosion of their 53-47 seat majority.
